objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage the patient presenting with altered mental status, autonomic dysregulation, and muscle rigidity.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I don’t know what you’re talking about—I think I’m being watched, and I’m not going to answer questions. I’m feeling extremely hot and confused, and I’ve been very sleepy and sometimes not responding. My body feels rigid, and something in me isn’t regulating right.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any yellowing, but I’m extremely hot and can’t think clearly. I feel very sleepy and sometimes I don’t respond, and my body feels stiff like it isn’t working right.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints or muscles when you wake up in the morning?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t wake up like normal—I’m already confused and extremely hot. My muscles feel rigid and stiff all over, not just in the morning, and I sometimes can’t stay responsive.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having night sweats—waking up with your clothes or bedding noticeably damp—at least a few nights recently?
turns.patient_answer: I’m not sure—I’ve been so confused and extremely hot that I can’t really tell about sweating at night, but I feel like my body’s not controlling itself and I’ve been very sleepy. I don’t feel able to answer much beyond that.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your thigh that feels like it’s within the muscle (not just on the skin)?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any specific lump or swelling in my thigh—I mostly feel extremely hot, confused, very sleepy, and my muscles feel rigid all over. I’m not really able to focus on or check for a swelling right now.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions, sores, or unusual bumps along the veins on your arm (for example, in a line where the veins run)?
turns.patient_answer: I can’t focus on my arms or notice bumps along the veins—I’m extremely hot, confused, and very sleepy. I also feel my body is stiff and not regulating right, so I don’t feel able to check or describe anything on my skin.

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever worked in a job where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, or working in a foundry or metal workshop?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t worked in anything like metal dust or fumes—I’m mostly dealing with being extremely hot and confused, very sleepy, and not staying responsive. My body feels rigid and like it’s not regulating right, and I still don’t want to answer questions because I think I’m being watched.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around your joints (for example, fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips), where the joint looks bigger or more “out of shape” than usual?
